item.title: A Seawater-Compatible Nanocluster Dilute Electrolyte for Low-Cost Long-Lifespan Four-Electron Zn–I2 Batteries
item.description:

ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a low-cost dilute nanocluster electrolyte (SBMA) that creates hydrophobic-interior nanoclusters, partitioning water into activated/nonactivated domains. This suppresses water activity, enables reversible I⁰/I⁺ conversion via quaternary ammonium–ICl₂⁻ coordination, and stabilizes the Zn anode. Significance: over 16,000 cycles at 10 A g⁻¹, and seawater-compatible operation exceeding 12,000 cycles, enabling sustainable, low-cost four-electron Zn–I₂ batteries.

item.title: Grading the evidence behind electronic-structure descriptors for lithium-sulfur cathode hosts
item.description:
این Perspective شواهد پشت توصیف‌گرهای ساختار الکترونی برای میزبان‌های کاتد لیتیوم-گوگرد را ارزیابی و درجه‌بندی می‌کند.
Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 💭 Perspective
💡 The novelty lies in critically grading, rather than assuming, the evidence behind electronic-structure descriptors used for Li-S cathode host design. Its significance is exposing weaknesses in descriptor-guided screening, clarifying which parameters are genuinely predictive, and guiding more rigorous, evidence-based materials selection for Li-S batteries.
🏷 lithium-sulfur battery · cathode host · electronic-structure descriptors · descriptor design · evidence grading

item.title: Single-Atom-Engineered Hard Carbon Anodes for Dendrite-Free Sodium Storage: A Density Functional Theory-Driven and Machine Learning-Assisted Design
item.description:

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers single-atom engineering of hard carbon anodes for dendrite-free sodium storage, uniquely integrating density functional theory with machine learning to guide design. It addresses the critical challenge of simultaneously regulating reversible Na storage and suppressing dendrites, offering a novel computational-experimental framework that advances rational development of high-performance, safe SIB anodes.
